value.rationale: This exact construction settles the universal diameter clause of a published, mathematically motivated conjecture, on the smallest connected graph size. The open family demonstrates a robust falsification in initial parameters and quantifies an unambiguous positive width excess. It exposes the role of initially inactive attractive links and the strict confidence boundary, giving concrete guidance on hypotheses a repair would require. It is not merely a routine special case or normalization check; the general proposed bound is false.
